name: SCOPE
summary: Constrain a new task before edits: deliverable, blast radius, plan, boundaries, stop condition.

cursor.rule_description: Use when a new task, feature, bugfix, or refactor starts and the agent must define the deliverable, allowed touch points, plan, and stop condition before editing.
cursor.skill_description: agentgrammar SCOPE — constrain a new task before edits (deliverable, blast radius, plan, boundaries). Use when the user invokes /agentgrammar-scope or starts a feature, bugfix, or refactor.
